about.text: I enjoy turning a messy industrial problem into a precise model, selecting the right algorithm, then turning the result into robust production software. My experience spans energy systems, aeronautics, simulation and decision-support applications.

projects.label: SELECTED WORK
projects.subtitle: A selection of technical and research projects across energy, aeronautics and industrial software.

p01.title: ENERBIRD / Hybrid Energy Management
p01.text: Optimal control and energy management for hybrid renewable power plants combining solar/wind generation and battery storage. Optimization models are coupled with forecasting and real-time operational constraints.

p02.title: E3S — Energy Smart Sailing Ship
p02.text: Hybrid intelligent energy-management system for a long-range sailing ship. The project combines renewable sources, diesel generation and battery storage with robust optimization under weather uncertainty.

p03.title: High-Voltage Substation Simulation
p03.text: Backend software development for simulation of high-voltage substation cards, with a strong focus on reliability, architecture, testing and maintainable modern C++.

p04.title: Air Traffic Conflict Resolution
p04.text: Exact and approximate approaches for resolving aircraft conflicts, exploring mathematical modeling, combinatorial optimization and metaheuristics in an air-traffic-management context.

e01.text: Optimization, forecasting and software solutions for hybrid renewable-energy systems and battery storage.

e02.text: Backend development and simulation software for high-voltage electrical-substation systems.

e03.text: Software engineering activities following the E3S research project, with C++ and Java development.

e04.text: Research project on intelligent energy management, robust optimization and uncertainty in renewable-energy systems.
